item.tib: dris lan 'bel gtam skabs lnga pa puN+Da rA+e ka'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni sa yos lor sgrub sde byang chub gling du bon sde ci rigs la 'chad nyan bgyid skabs/ 'dzin tha ba 'ga' la nyer mkho'i ched du bslab pa dris lan zhig bris nas tshogs langs skabs kyi 'dzin thor spel mtshams/ sde dge nas mdo khams bstan pa'i bdag po 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i yang srid rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros kyi zhal snga nas/ bon gyi bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin byon tshul dang 'brel ba'i lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi rnam bzhag dang gzhung lugs gtso che bzhugs tshul rnams gsal ba'i rnam bshad cig gyis shig pa'i bka' brtsal bzhin khod spungs kyi rus su byung ba'i gshen gyi drang srong rigs pa smra ba dbra ston bskal (skal)bzang bstan rgyal zhes 'bod pas skabs lnga po rdzogs par sbyar nas bzhed skong du bgyis pa ste gshen bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur cig/
